blocks.title: Isomers
blocks.text: Do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik ho lekin atoms ki tarteeb aur khasiyatein mukhtalif hon, isomers hain; is amal ko isomerism kehte hain.

items: Jab wahi atoms ya groups mukhtalif jagahon par jure hon to structural (constitutional) isomerism hoti hai: chain, position aur functional group isomers, metamers aur tautomers, jo Chemistry XI mein parhe gaye.
Jab atoms usi tarteeb se jure hon lekin khala mein mukhtalif tarteeb (mukhtalif configuration) ho to stereoisomerism hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Chart. Isomers (aik molecular formula) constitutional ya structural isomers (chain, position, functional group, metamers, tautomers) aur stereoisomers mein bat'te hain. Stereoisomers conformational (single bonds par ghoom kar aik doosre mein badalne wale) aur configurational mein; configurational optical isomers aur geometrical (cis-trans, C=C par ruki gardish) mein; optical isomers enantiomers (aaina shakalein jo aik doosre par na baithein) aur diastereomers (aaina shakal nahi) mein.
blocks.caption: Isomers ki taqseem (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Isomers pehle is par bat'te hain ke un ke atoms usi tarteeb se jure hain ya nahi. Constitutional isomers ke jor mukhtalif hain. Stereoisomers ke jor wahi lekin khala mein tarteeb mukhtalif hai: conformational isomers sirf single bonds par ghoom kar aik doosre mein badalte, jab ke configurational isomers, optical ya geometrical, bonds tore baghair nahi badal sakte.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C2H6O hain. Yeh kis qism ke isomers hain?
blocks.explanation: Constitutional (structural) isomers, khaas taur par functional group isomers: aik alcohol aur aik ether.

items: Isomers: aik molecular formula, mukhtalif tarteeb aur khasiyatein.
Constitutional: mukhtalif jor. Stereoisomers: wahi jor, khala mein mukhtalif tarteeb.
